summary: Wave 1 backend + frontend smoke — 20/20 backend pytest passed. Verified: 9-role Literal + user creation for all 8 non-admin roles; 2-step sale approval (rep books -> booked_pending_sales_approval; head approves -> sale_confirmed); sales_head/super_admin self-approve skips pending; reject clears owner fields + resets status to available; 3-step payment flow claim(post_sales_rep) -> verify(accounts_rep, reflected/not_reflected) -> approve(accounts_head) -> paid + Payment record created; partial when received<amount; unit rolls up to fully_paid; promise-to-pay preserves original due_date; RBAC (sales_rep 403 on sales-review, accounts_rep 403 on approve, process_admin 403 on create/delete/promote super_admin); UnitStatus Literal has all 14 states; /api/onboarding/status returns 7 steps + counts map (accounts/management/sales/crm/site_supervisor); regression auth (forgot-password, /auth/me, 5-fail lockout).
